title: Banteay Srei

buildingCutout.basis: Only the mapped central temple building is represented; independent modern facilities remain native.

terrainReference.basis: SourceY0 is the retained standard Mapzen sample at the raw anchor. Individual plinths use their local coarse grade with retaining foundations. The common platform is an approximate graded stone terrace. Original ground and native moat water stay intact; exact archaeological floors and seasonal water levels are not surveyed.
